spatial_claims.claim: D is a point taken within circle ABC
More than two equal straight lines fall from D on circle ABC
Assumption: D is not the centre of the circle

By 3.7, since D is inside circle ABC and not the centre, the greatest line from D to the circle passes through the centre, the least is the remainder of that diameter, and only two equal straight lines fall from D on the circle (one on each side of the least)
More than two equal lines from hypothesis contradicts 3.7 conclusion of only two equal lines when D is not the centre
